description: Image Description: The image shows a silhouette of several birds perched on electrical wires that radiate outward from a central utility pole. The background is a warm, orange-yellow hue, suggesting a sunset or sunrise scene. The birds are evenly distributed across the wires, and their dark outlines contrast sharply against the bright backdrop, highlighting their shapes and positions. The utility pole and wires create a radial pattern, adding a sense of symmetry to the composition.
